facts.fact: TechCabal reports that Awarri, with the Nigerian government, has released N-ATLAS language models in Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, accented Nigerian English and most recently Pidgin, trained on voice data collected through LangEasy with 3MTT support.

systems.platform: open-source LLM; trained on Amazon and Google cloud
systems.owner: Awarri with the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
